info.name: NI Direct - School Closures (Exceptional Closures API mock)
info.description: Mock endpoints for the Exceptional Closures API, built from the nidirect_school_closures kernel test fixtures (tests/src/Kernel/data). Import this collection, then create a Postman Mock Server from it to get a URL you can plug into the module's "Data source URL" setting (/admin/config/nidirect/school-closures) for manual/browser testing.

variable.description: Filled in automatically when this collection is opened via its Postman mock server URL.

request.description: No query params - this is the example Postman serves by default when the mock URL is hit directly, matching how the Drupal service calls the real API.
